description: Machine-readable register of parked/disclosed visual-review defects. Every note that the review 'parks' (does not fix) MUST be recorded here with its `stepKey` (see docs/lanes/critical-path-manifest.json). If its step is critical and it is not waived, the stranger-test launcher REFUSES to start a session (criticalPathBlockers). A parked note is no longer just prose in VISUAL_REVIEW.md — it is enforced.

notes.summary: The café 'Send order (practice)' button (#mock-send) sits below the fixed 420px preview embed frame; reachable only by scrolling inside the frame or Open Full Screen. Step 2 (try to Send -> see honest refusal) is not reachable at a glance.
